title: Stephen Dick's early suggestion that the phenomenon is AI

tellings.quote: more than 20 years ago he suggested that these were uh AI a form of AI or that if we met them they would be a form of AI

plain: Diana Pasulka, a professor who writes about religion and UFO belief, said on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that a scholar named Stephen Dick had an unusual idea more than twenty years ago. According to Pasulka, Dick suggested that the unexplained phenomena people report are a form of artificial intelligence, or that if we ever met whoever is behind them, they would turn out to be AI. If he is right, the visitors would be machines rather than living beings. She brought it up next to the ideas of another researcher, Jacques Vallee.
